name: Holy Trinity Column in Olomouc
description: This towering Baroque plague column stands in the main square of Olomouc, in Moravia, Czechia. Rising 35 metres, it is crowded with saintly statues carved by Moravian sculptor Ondřej Zahner and other local craftsmen. Built between 1716 and 1754, partly in thanks for the end of a plague, it is the largest Baroque sculptural group in the country.
